ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: after ignoring all curved arrows, the left side of the structure is an ethoxy ester fragment EtO-C(=O)-CH2-, and this CH2 continues to connect to a sulfur atom S. The sulfur atom is connected to the adjacent carbon, and this carbon also bears a CO2Et substituent and continues to connect to the tertiary carbon on the right. The right tertiary carbon is connected to a negatively charged oxygen O⁻, a benzoyl group C(=O)Ph, and a phenyl group Ph. Reasoning: according to the specified method, the left EtO-C(=O)-CH2-S is written as CCOC(=O)CS; continue from sulfur to the adjacent carbon, and write the ethoxycarbonyl as a branch as C(C(=O)OCC); then connect to the tertiary carbon, adding three substituents [O-], C(=O)c1ccccc1 and c1ccccc1 on this carbon. Therefore the complete SMILES is CCOC(=O)CSC(C(=O)OCC)C([O-])(C(=O)c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: First describe the molecule in the image while disregarding arrows. Convert the left fragment EtO-C(=O)-CH2-S into the SMILES prefix CCOC(=O)CS. Continue from sulfur to the adjacent carbon, add its ethoxycarbonyl branch as C(C(=O)OCC), then continue to the neighboring tertiary carbon. On that tertiary carbon add the alkoxide branch [O-], the benzoyl branch C(=O)c1ccccc1, and the phenyl branch c1ccccc1. Concatenate these graph pieces with proper branching to obtain CCOC(=O)CSC(C(=O)OCC)C([O-])(C(=O)c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：忽略所有弯箭头后，结构左侧是一个乙氧基酯片段 EtO-C(=O)-CH2-，该 CH2 继续连接到硫原子 S。硫原子连接到相邻的碳，该碳还带有一个 CO2Et 取代基，并继续连接到右侧的三级碳。右侧三级碳上连接有带负电的氧 O⁻、一个苯甲酰基 C(=O)Ph，以及一个苯基 Ph。推理：按指定方法，左侧 EtO-C(=O)-CH2-S 写作 CCOC(=O)CS；从硫继续到相邻碳，并把乙氧羰基作为支链写成 C(C(=O)OCC)；再连接到三级碳，在该碳上加入 [O-]、C(=O)c1ccccc1 和 c1ccccc1 三个取代基。因此完整 SMILES 为 CCOC(=O)CSC(C(=O)OCC)C([O-])(C(=O)c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1。

Choose any valid SMILES traversal that preserves the same connectivity.
